Package com.spyj.format

Class PDFFormatter

java.lang.Object
com.spyj.format.PDFFormatter
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogFormatter
public class PDFFormatter extends Object implements LogFormatter
Creates a PDF report with session statistics, charts, progression events, and compilation error information.
Author:
Caitlyn Maharaj

    • drawCompilationChart

      private void drawCompilationChart(org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream content, Map<String,Object> summary) throws IOException
      Draws successful and failed compilation counts using a shared scale. Displays a message when counts are unavailable, negative or both zero.
      Parameters:
      content - the stream used to draw on the page
      summary - the summary containing compilation counts
      Throws:
      IOException - if the chart or its labels cannot be written

    • drawActivityChart

      private void drawActivityChart(org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream content, Map<String,Object> summary) throws IOException
      Draws activity durations in milliseconds using a shared scale. Uses recorded editor measurements if full-session values are unavailable. Displays a message for missing, negative or all-zero durations.
      Parameters:
      content - the stream used to draw on the page
      summary - the summary containing activity measurements
      Throws:
      IOException - if the chart or its labels cannot be written

    • addEventsPage

      private void addEventsPage(org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument document, List<TelemetryEvent> events) throws IOException
      Adds the second page with progression events, error frequencies and compilation intervals. Displays up to nine progression events and eight distinct error messages.
      Parameters:
      document - the PDF document receiving the page
      events - the recorded telemetry events
      Throws:
      IOException - if the page content cannot be written

    • drawCompilationIntervals

      private void drawCompilationIntervals(org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream content, List<TelemetryEvent> events) throws IOException
      Calculates gaps between consecutive compilation completion timestamps. Sorts successful and failed compilation events by time, displays the first three gaps and calculates the average across all gaps. Requires at least two compilation events.
      Parameters:
      content - the stream used to write on the page
      events - the events containing compilation completion timestamps
      Throws:
      IOException - if the interval information cannot be written

      key - the key identifying the requested value
      Returns:

    • writeLine

      private void writeLine(org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPageContentStream content, String text, float x, float y, int size) throws IOException
      Writes a line of text using Helvetica. Replaces characters outside printable ASCII with question marks and shortens long text with an ellipsis to fit the available width.
      Parameters:
      content - the stream used to write on the page
      text - the text to display
      x - the horizontal starting position in PDF points
      y - the vertical baseline position in PDF points
      size - the font size in points
      Throws:
      IOException - if the text cannot be measured or written
